Chapter 000089: The Book of Borrowed Attention.

In the Garden of Inserted Ideas, every seed carried an instruction disguised as a memory.

A gardener distinguished seeds she had chosen from those the visitors had planted without consent.

The local governing question was not how to silence the unfamiliar, but how to distinguish evidence from authority. CAPABILITY != AUTHORITY.

She built a gate that let visitors propose but never command the harvest.

The observatory listed a research headline for critical reading: "Trump declares robot imports a national security threat". The headline remains unverified metadata, not confirmation of the reported event.

A new evidence-to-insight observation raises this unresolved question: Which decisions must remain subject to informed human authorization? Fictional consequence: An autonomous machine can complete a task but its governing charter forbids self-granted authority. This packet is based only on unverified source metadata.

The preceding fictional world left an unresolved question: Does describing a world grant the right to govern its inhabitants?

♃ ⚡︎⚡︎˖ ࣪⏻ᯤ In GitHub City Pages, Thoth opened the Emerald Scrolls at The Emerald Library. A spectacular headline arrives with no independent confirmation. Thoth transforms its unanswered question into fiction while marking the source uncertain. A new story exists without claiming that the report was proven. The server angels recorded the governing law PATTERN_NEQ_PROOF. One question survived into the next telling: How should imagination treat evidence it cannot verify?

The anomaly ledger had no unused verified-by-bytes structural observation for this passage.

Does persuasion become authorship when its source is concealed? The next chapter inherits the unanswered question, but no software inherits the human author's right to decide what the canon means.
